ruby._note: UPDATE 2026-11-22: 3.4.13 is the newest 3.4 on ruby-lang.org (released 2026-11-18; index.txt sha256 and the release announcement; the tarball downloaded 2026-11-22 hashes to it). It replaces 3.4.12 for GHSA-34m4-m9fh-gqp5, GHSA-7x2q-68qv-6p8x, GHSA-3p8q-wmhx-vm2w (critical), CVE-2026-132825 and GHSA-87fm-7w84-j2px, GHSA-wpqw-5qxg-m68r, GHSA-7whj-cfh7-xgm4 (high): seven Regexp and String case-conversion bugs, some with public PoCs for remote code execution, fixed in 4.0.10, 3.4.13 and 3.3.14 (ruby-lang.org advisory, 2026-11-18). Earlier notes below were written for 3.4.12 and name it as it was then. Gemfile.d/_before.rb: ruby '>= 3.4.1' (the lock records 3.4.1); upstream's Dockerfile.production builds on Ruby 3.4. 3.4.12 is the newest 3.4 on ruby-lang.org (released 2026-10-23; index.txt sha256, read 2026-11-08). It replaces 3.4.11 (r1, r2) for CVE-2026-97229 (CISA KEV since 2026-10-29): an integer overflow in the size of a compiled regular expression in Ruby's Onigmo engine (ruby/ruby #19020), fixed in 3.4.12 together with the bugs behind CVE-2026-89078, CVE-2026-93577 and CVE-2026-110264 (ruby-lang.org, 2026-10-23). 3.4.11 -> 3.4.12 (26 commits) changes the interpreter's C sources, no file under lib/ and not gems/bundled_gems: its default and bundled gems are 3.4.11's. gem_updates: Ruby 3.4.12 bundles net-imap 0.5.15 (as 3.4.11 did); the app's bundle resolves net-imap 0.6.8 (the GHSA-vcgp-9326-pqcp floor 0.6.4.1), and the image carried both until chain 617's held review (2026-10-22) found the release record naming 0.5.15. Replacing Ruby's copy with 0.6.8 leaves one net-imap in the image.
